name: AI-Job-Application-Copilot
description: AI-powered job search assistant: resume analysis, job matching with skill-gap insights, tailored resumes and cover letters, interview coaching, and an application tracker. Free rule-based tier, optional AI Pro. React + Express + Prisma + Postgres, deployed on Vercel.

paragraphs: Paste a job description, pick your resume and see how well your real experience fits: an estimated match score, skill gaps, resume fixes, tailoring suggestions, interview questions and a cover letter — then track the job from Saved to Offer.
